definitions.explanation: A six-sided polygon or anything having six corners or angles. Used in geometry, design, and to describe physical shapes.

examples.japanese: {蜂|はち}の{巣|す}は{六角|ろっかく}の{形|かたち}をしている。
{六角|ろっかく}レンチでネジを{締|し}めてください。
examples.english: Please tighten the screw with a hex wrench.

examples.japanese: この{建物|たてもの}の{断面|だんめん}は{六角|ろっかく}になっていて、とても{珍|めずら}しいデザインだ。
examples.english: The cross-section of this building is hexagonal — a very unusual design.

notes:
Composed of {六|ろく} (six) and {角|かく} (angle/corner). Refers to both the geometric shape (hexagon) and the property of being six-sided (hexagonal).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {六角|ろっかく}レンチ: hex wrench / Allen key
- {六角|ろっかく}{形|けい}: hexagonal shape
- {六角|ろっかく}ボルト: hex bolt
- {六角|ろっかく}{柱|ちゅう}: hexagonal prism
- {正|せい}{六角|ろっかく}{形|けい}: regular hexagon

RELATED WORDS:
- {三角|さんかく}: triangle — three angles
- {四角|しかく}: square/rectangle — four angles
- {五角|ごかく}: pentagon — five angles
- {八角|はっかく}: octagon — eight angles
